links.text:
Ex-OpenAI science head @kevinweil on his $215M plan to build robotic labs that run 24/7 and bring drug research back from China:

"We’re building robotic labs that do science at scale, and we’re doing it here in America. Doing science at scale is the way we generate the training data the models desperately need."

"We need to reshore scientific capabilities from China so that we don’t lose our pharma industry the way that we lost solar and drones and manufacturing."

"We’re not developing drugs on our own, we are building the infrastructure so that everybody who does develop drugs can go faster."
@warpsciences

quote.text:
💥 Introducing Warp Sciences, a new company applying AI and robotics to help the world develop new medicines faster. 

We’ve raised a $215M Series A led by @lightspeedvp to bring frontier AI out of the browser and into the lab, and build scientific capacity here in America.

I co-founded Warp with my long-time friend @dpatil, FAIR co-founder @manohar_paluri, and drug hunter Sol Reisberg. The early team is full of incredible people like @bkspears9, who helped achieve Q>1 fusion at LLNL.
